_meta.description: AutoDEX B9 consumer — runtime skill policy decisions. The soc_argus_skill_policy_applier workflow reads .soc-skill-recommendations rows with verdict in {demote, reprompt} and upserts one row per skill_id into this index. Doc id == skill_id so the policy state is always the most-recent decision per skill. Read by future MCP-side admission gates that refuse to invoke `enabled: false` skills and surface `prompt_revision_required: true` to skill maintainers.
